cases.title: Increase quantity updates line total and cart total

steps.action: In a cart containing one 'Blue Mug' at 12.00, change the quantity field from 1 to 3
steps.expected: The line total shows 36.00 and the cart total updates to 36.00 without a page reload

cases.title: Increasing quantity updates the line total and the cart total

steps.action: In a cart containing one 'Blue Mug' at 12.00, change the quantity field from 1 to 3
steps.expected: The line total shows 36.00 and the cart total updates to 36.00 without a page reload

cases.title: Quantity above stock snaps to maximum

steps.action: With 4 units in stock, set the quantity to 10
steps.expected: The field snaps to 4 and a notice says only 4 are available

cases.title: Setting quantity to zero removes the item with undo

steps.action: Wait 6 seconds after setting quantity to 0 again
steps.expected: The item is gone from the cart and the undo toast has disappeared

steps.action: Type -2 into the quantity field and press Tab
steps.expected: The previous quantity is restored and no request is sent
